executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
Server is running in OpenAPI/REST mode at http://127.0.0.1:8080 with --no-auth (no API key required). No live SSH or Proxmox infrastructure is available — tests targeting external hosts should expect HTTP 424 Failed Dependency (with status=failed_dependency, host, port, protocol, requires fields) when the TCP preflight cannot reach the target. Treat 424 as the expected/correct response for unreachable-target scenarios, not a failure. Standalone tools (list_available_services, get_service_info, list_registered_servers, get_network_sitemap, analyze_network_topology, suggest_deployments, get_device_changes, search_proxmox_scripts, get_proxmox_script_info) should return 200.</additionalInstruction>
